title: Quasi-compactness descends along a universally open surjective morphism of algebraic spaces

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if g : Y' -> Y is universally open and surjective and the base change f' : X' -> Y' of f : X -> Y is quasi-compact, then f is quasi-compact (source lines 1350-1357). The proof tests quasi-compactness on a quasi-compact Z over Y: the base change Y' x_Y Z -> Z is open and surjective, and because the points of |Y' x_Y Z| admit fundamental systems of quasi-compact open neighbourhoods one can find a quasi-compact open W of |Y' x_Y Z| surjecting onto Z; the base change W x_Y X is quasi-compact by hypothesis and surjects onto Z x_Y X, so Z x_Y X is quasi-compact.
